about: Inputs of tools/token_economics.py for docs/research/2026-09-26-token-economics.md. Every number has a kind: measured (this machine, docs/bench), sourced (sources.json), derived (computed from the others by the tool), assumed (operator/agent assumption, change freely).

prefill_tok_s.src: measured single-user f16 TTFT 2.49 s at 3,223 tokens (1,294 tok/s) and 10.14 s at 12,034 tokens (1,187 tok/s), docs/bench/2026-09-24-gemm-f16x-isa.md; rounded down for parallel mode (interference scenario of docs/bench/2026-09-25-multiuser.md implies ~1,160 tok/s while 6 users decode)

modes.name: 1 user, MTP speculation
